author: Codex GPT-6-Astra handwritten narrow procedure; no optimizer generation
purpose: Find whether an explicit source-event-to-target-state dependency procedure helps under natural selection on fixed Train400
hypothesis: For explicitly synchronized or time-mapped distinct videos, establishing a source event anchor before issuing its dependent target request reduces unsupported temporal handoffs and improves whole-library official score.

motivating_evidence.scope: Legal Train Global public history only; initial concurrent target requests used a not-yet-returned source event time, and another request supplied an unsupported candidate window.
motivating_evidence.stated_sync_prerequisite: The relevant public questions explicitly provide synchronization; applicability is not inferred from IDs, equal duration or the word when.
motivating_evidence.limit: Instruction-dependency evidence, not verified local visual truth or prior proof that this new program works; exact case/event references remain in private review.

execution_order.first: Run canonical first40 as execution and natural-selection diagnostic; these40 are included in400.
execution_order.then: Complete the fixed remaining360 regardless of prefix score; do not select, rewrite or stop the candidate from prefix results.
execution_order.on_infrastructure_failure: Preserve failed evidence, repair only the execution failure and resume missing units; never replace panel members or repeat successful results.
execution_order.deadline: Respect the original absolute study deadline; do not dispatch work beyond it, preserve unfinished units if time expires, and never call a prefix the full result.

baseline.policy: Read-only reuse of completed matching Train400 answers and original scores; no empty inference or Judge repeat.

runtime.selection: Natural Global one card or none; selected strategy retained per question. Video skill disabled because its bank is empty.
runtime.actor_and_judge_protocol: Same frozen8ff Actor/eval source, weights, numeric/media/budget/official-score and fixed Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 Judge identities as completed Train400; no frozen implementation changes.

primary_readout: R minus reused empty official ten-task macro on all400, with actual CCQA point denominators.
secondary_readout: R minus completed P is posthoc descriptive only: card content, scope, library competition and Video activation differ, so this is not a single-G2 causal revision.
mechanism_predictions: For naturally selected eligible requests, dependent target lookup follows already supported source anchoring or an already completed joint result.
Supplied initialization and event qualifiers are preserved, and any target query uses a valid time mapped by the question's given correspondence.
Improved official score should be accompanied by a supported public event-to-target relation, not merely an unsupported answer guess.
falsifiers: The procedure continues to issue dependent target requests before the source result or invents temporal windows.
The intended ordering is followed without a whole-library score benefit on the fixed panel.
Score repairs lack a repaired public evidence chain; those repairs do not establish the proposed mechanism.
statistics: Reuse official pooled task/CCQA weighting and existing paired/source-group sensitivity with seed0; report improvements/regressions/ties, actual selection/injection and token logs. Do not average shard or route-group accuracies.
scope_limits: One narrow Global card is a finite isolation experiment for discovering composable programs, not a new single-card final objective or mandatory card count.
Train development with repeated use; no independent confirmation, general style superiority or cross-model/benchmark transfer claim.
Headings are a readability choice; S-P on the prior completed matrix did not establish a superior format.
None remains legal; usage rate, lower cost or fewer steps are not acceptance objectives.
Textual and synthetic counterexample checks do not establish execution, evidence truth or accuracy.
The quarantined public-review case is excluded from mechanism/proposal evidence but retained in official score totals; no private content is used.
prior_Gate: Already used for the original candidate package and rejected; unavailable for this experiment.
